flagshipProjects.name: IMPOSTR
flagshipProjects.summary: AI-assisted domain and URL threat-forensics platform aggregating multi-source threat telemetry, DNS/WHOIS/SSL data, and NLP-based heuristic analysis to assess suspicious infrastructure in under 2 seconds.
flagshipProjects.problem: Traditional phishing detection relies on slow manual blacklists or single-point checks. Attackers quickly cycle disposable domains and polymorphic hosting infrastructure, evading legacy static filters before feeds update.
flagshipProjects.solution: Aggregates live threat feeds (URLhaus, PhishTank, OpenPhish), automated SSL certificate transparency logs (crt.sh), DNS history, and an NLP scanner into a consolidated forensic score.
contributions: Engineered threat telemetry collection pipeline querying multiple OSINT feeds asynchronously.
Built multi-vector URL forensic scoring engine evaluating domain age, certificate trust, and lexical entropy.
Created interactive investigation interface and node relationship graph visualization.
Reduced average lookup latency from 6.8s to 1.4s using parallel asynchronous worker routines.
flagshipProjects.limitations: Subject to public OSINT API rate limits during high-volume spikes.

flagshipProjects.name: LUCERNA
flagshipProjects.disclaimer: Prototype under development, not a clinically validated diagnostic product.
flagshipProjects.summary: AI-assisted radiological imaging review workstation centering on auditable human-in-the-loop oversight, structured reviewability, and clinician verification interfaces.
flagshipProjects.problem: Automated healthcare AI models are frequently treated as 'black boxes', causing clinician distrust, high alert fatigue, and lack of accountability in diagnostic support.
flagshipProjects.solution: Built around verifiable human-in-the-loop workflows. Highlights candidate regions of interest, calculates spatial confidence overlays, and mandates explicit clinician sign-off rather than declaring automated diagnoses.
contributions: Designed clinician triage UI, reviewability flows, and candidate heatmap inspection.
Architected medical image inspection canvas viewport with side-by-side comparison and contrast windowing presets.
Implemented human-in-the-loop discrepancy logging and clinician audit trail schema.
Prototyped client-side zero-cloud WebGL/ONNX pre-processing to safeguard sensitive patient records on local clinical intranets.
flagshipProjects.limitations: Model training dataset strictly limited to open-access anonymized research benchmarks.

flagshipProjects.name: DORMEX
flagshipProjects.summary: Hostel and campus accommodation management platform streamlining room allocation, vacancy locks, and maintenance complaint lifecycles.
flagshipProjects.problem: University hostel allocation often depends on paper forms, untracked spreadsheets, and disorganized counter queues, resulting in double-booked beds and lost maintenance requests.
flagshipProjects.solution: Provides an integrated platform separating student portals, warden verification panels, and real-time room capacity tracking with automated waitlisting.
contributions: Designed relational PostgreSQL schema with partial unique indexes (uq_seat_current, uq_student_current) preventing race conditions and double bookings.
Built server-authoritative seat allocation engine and turn scheduler with ACID transactional safety.
Implemented role-based access control (Student, Proctor, Warden, Chief Warden, Super Admin).
Authored zero-dependency test harness supporting live PostgreSQL and embedded in-memory database (pg-mem).
